items.name: Amulet
items.description: A small charm or pendant, often imbued with magical properties.

items.name: Book
items.effect: Boon on skill rolls about its subject. Price depends on the subject.
items.description: A tome filled with knowledge, often containing spells or ancient lore.

items.name: Brooch
items.description: A decorative pin or clasp, often used to fasten clothing.

items.name: Chalk
items.description: A piece of chalk, often used for drawing or writing on surfaces.

items.name: Grimoire
items.effect: Price depends on the contents and can run far higher.
items.description: A book of spells and magical knowledge, often written in an ancient language.

items.name: Hourglass
items.description: A device used to measure time, often made of glass and sand.

items.name: Notebook
items.effect: Blank. Works as a grimoire once filled.
items.description: A blank notebook, perfect for jotting down notes or sketches.

items.name: Orbuculum
items.description: A crystal ball or orb, often used for divination or scrying.

items.name: Paper
items.description: A single sheet of paper, often used for writing or drawing.

items.name: Parchment
items.description: A piece of parchment, often used for writing or drawing.

items.name: Quill & Ink
items.description: A quill pen and ink, often used for writing or drawing.

items.name: Reliquary
items.description: A container for holding relics or sacred objects, often used in religious practices.

items.name: Wand
items.description: A slender stick or rod, often used as a magical focus or tool.
